GRAND GROUP CORPORATION is a prominent chemical enterprise headquartered at Unit 13F, Pacific Plaza, No. 555 Jingjia Road, Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, China. Strategically located in one of China’s most dynamic industrial and port cities, the company has established itself as a key player in the diversified chemicals sector, serving both domestic and international markets. With a steadfast commitment to innovation, quality, and sustainable development, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION specializes in the research, development, production, and distribution of a wide array of chemical products, including specialty chemicals, industrial additives, performance materials, and fine chemicals used across various industries such as textiles, plastics, automotive, electronics, and pharmaceuticals.

Founded with a vision to bridge advanced chemical solutions with evolving market demands, the company leverages cutting-edge technology and a highly skilled R&D team to deliver customized, high-performance products that meet rigorous international standards. GRAND GROUP CORPORATION adheres to strict quality control protocols and environmental management systems, ensuring compliance with global regulations, including REACH, ISO, and other industry-specific certifications. Its proximity to the Port of Ningbo-Zhoushan—one of the world’s busiest ports—enables efficient logistics and timely delivery to clients across Asia, Europe, and North America.

With a customer-centric approach and a focus on continuous improvement, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION is not only driving growth in China’s chemical industry but is also expanding its global footprint through strategic partnerships, sustainable practices, and technological excellence. The company remains dedicated to contributing to industrial advancement while promoting environmental stewardship and corporate responsibility.
